summary: A tenant signing for two years at {building} gets one year before the guideline permits a higher rent.
realLife: Under the 2020 New York City order a covered two-year renewal had a zero first-year adjustment and a one-percent allowance in its second year.
gates: The case record identifies the order, lease term and anniversary.
inGame: needs: order, lease term and anniversary.

turns.pulledBy: The first anniversary is still ahead

turns.what: The owner can apply the stated second-year allowance.
